mapper.sql: select chat_id, device_id, session_id, role, content, used_llm, create_time from cl_app_ai_chat
mapper.insert: insert into cl_app_ai_chat (device_id, session_id, role, content, used_llm, create_time) values (#{deviceId}, #{sessionId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{usedLlm}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: where device_id = #{deviceId} and session_id = #{sessionId} order by create_time asc, chat_id asc
mapper.delete: delete from cl_app_ai_chat where device_id = #{deviceId} and session_id = #{sessionId}
